algorithm: sha256(seed + ':' + video_id) -> uniform[0,1] via top 16 hex digits; sort videos by this score; first floor(N*0.80) videos (by ID, tie-broken by sorted video_id order after scoring) become val_tune, remainder become val_confirm. Partitioning key is video_id only -- every question/event row inherits its video's partition, so no video ever appears in more than one partition.
